items.headline: Breece Hall powers Jets past Titans 23-10 in a dominant season opener against their former coach
items.description: — Breece Hall ran for 102 yards and a touchdown, Geno Smith threw for 215 yards in his Jets return and the New York Jets defeated Tennessee 23-10 on Sunday in the season opener to spoil Titans coach Robert Saleh's debut against his former team.
